name: PODS Tailgate
tagline: The ultimate Razorback tailgate in the Gardens.

hero.title: PODS Tailgate. Let's Party.
hero.text: Awesome people, unbeatable food, cold drinks, and Razorback pride like no other. Every home game, in the Gardens.

location.short: Razorback Gardens, directly in front of the Bathroom Pavilion.
location.long: We are in the Gardens directly in front of the Bathroom Pavilion. If you can find the Pavilion, you will find us.

parking.withoutPass: Fayetteville High School lot — usually about $20, not a far walk, and a great cause.

venmo.name: Ben Pierce
venmo.suggested: Give what feels right — about $10 an adult if you hang out for a while. Kids are always on us. All proceeds fund the tailgate.
